title: Host Error - CPU or Memory Execution Budget Exceeded
summary: Contract execution terminated because CPU instruction count or memory allocation exceeded specified envelope limits.
symptoms: Transaction simulation or invocation returns HostError::BudgetExceeded. CLI displays Error: HostError(Error(Budget, Exceeded)). Contract fails during high-iteration loops or heavy math.
root_causes:
1. Unbounded loops over persistent storage vectors.
2. Heavy WASM crypto computation instead of host primitives.
3. Large memory allocations exceeding byte limits.
solutions:
1. Chunk operations into smaller batches across multiple transactions.
2. Use built-in host functions like env.crypto().sha256().
3. In test harness, raise budget with env.budget().reset_unlimited().

title: Host Error - Storage Entry Archived or TTL Expired
summary: Attempted access to a persistent or instance storage entry whose Time-To-Live (TTL) has expired and been moved to archived state.
symptoms: Call fails with error string Storage, ExceededStateArchival. Transaction simulation rejects access with ContractData entry archived.
root_causes:
1. Storage entry reached 0 remaining TTL ledgers without renewal.
2. Accessing persistent storage without preceding RestoreFootprint transaction.
solutions:
1. Proactively extend TTL using env.storage().persistent().extend_ttl(&key, threshold, extend_to).
2. Submit a RestoreFootprint operation via Soroban CLI: soroban contract restore --id <CONTRACT_ID>.

title: Host Error - WASM Unreachable Code Reached (Panic)
summary: WASM virtual machine hit an explicit panic instruction, unhandled unwrapping of None/Err, or out-of-bounds index execution.
symptoms: Call fails with HostError(Error(WasmVm, Unexpected)). Terminal log reports VM trapped: unreachable code executed.
root_causes:
1. Calling .unwrap() or .expect() on None or Err.
2. Indexing array out of bounds (vec[index]).
3. Integer division by zero.
solutions:
1. Avoid .unwrap(). Return Result<T, ContractError> instead.
2. Perform explicit zero-checks and bounds checking prior to math.

title: Host Error - Cross-Contract Sub-Invocation Failed
summary: Cross-contract call to child contract returned an unhandled error or panic.
symptoms: Parent contract invocation aborts with Error(Context, Failed). RPC log indicates sub-invocation stack unwound.
root_causes:
1. Child contract panicking or hitting host error.
2. Calling non-existent function name or symbol mismatch.
solutions:
1. Verify target contract existence on-chain.
2. Propagate or inspect child contract execution logs.

title: Host Error - Contract Code or Instance Not Found
summary: Host environment failed to locate WASM executable bytecode or instance storage for given contract ID.
symptoms: Call fails with Error(Storage, MissingValue) or ContractNotFound.
root_causes:
1. Typo in target contract address.
2. Network mismatch (Testnet contract invoked against Mainnet RPC).
3. WASM code hash not uploaded.
solutions:
1. Re-check deployment output logs for exact address.
2. Confirm network flag (--network testnet / mainnet) matches deployment.

title: CLI Error - Identity Account Not Found on Network
summary: Soroban CLI configured source identity account is not funded or does not exist on the target network.
symptoms: CLI displays Error: Account G... not found on network.
root_causes:
1. Newly generated keypair has zero XLM balance.
2. Using wrong keypair alias.
reproduction_steps:
soroban keys generate alice
soroban contract deploy --wasm contract.wasm --source alice
solutions:
1. Fund account via Friendbot: soroban keys fund alice --network testnet.
2. Transfer native XLM to public key before deployment.

title: CLI Error - Transaction Failed Bad Sequence Number
summary: Transaction submission rejected because account sequence number did not match network sequence counter.
root_causes:
1. Multiple concurrent transactions submitted using identical source account.
2. CLI local sequence cache out of sync with RPC node state.
reproduction_steps: Submit two transactions simultaneously from separate terminals with same --source keypair.
solutions:
1. Retry transaction to auto-refresh sequence counter.
2. Use channel accounts for high-throughput batching.

title: RPC Error - Simulate Transaction Authorization Verification Failed
summary: Simulation node failed to verify invocation authorization payload or signature footprint.
symptoms: RPC returns Simulation failed: Auth error.
root_causes:
1. Signer key does not match require_auth address.
2. Missing sub-invocation footprint.
reproduction_steps: Pass signature from keypair B to a function demanding address_a.require_auth().
solutions:
1. Ensure signer key matches target address payload.
2. Use assembleTransaction in JS SDK to compute auth trees automatically.

title: RPC Error - Requested Ledger Storage Key Missing
summary: RPC getLedgerEntries endpoint returned empty result for requested XDR storage key.
symptoms: getLedgerEntries response returns empty entries list.
root_causes:
1. Storage key was never initialized.
2. Key expired and was archived.
reproduction_steps: Query contract instance storage key for address prior to initialization.
solutions:
1. Execute contract setup/init function first.
2. Query state archival RPC endpoint to check restoration status.

title: SDK Error - ScVal to Native JavaScript/Rust Value Conversion Failed
summary: Soroban SDK failed to deserialize raw XDR ScVal into target programming language primitive or struct.
symptoms: TypeError: Cannot convert ScVal to native type.
root_causes:
1. Decoding ScVal::Symbol as ScVal::I128 or ScVal::Address.
2. SDK bindings schema drift.
reproduction_steps: Pass string argument in JS SDK to function expecting i128.
solutions:
1. Use type-safe generated client bindings (soroban contract bindings).
2. Use scValToNative() helper with explicit type casting.
